notes: Separate dependency-free Cargo lifecycle, not seven-case history100.

Same immutable compiler/runtime image, root generation-scoped cooperative Docker sessions versus UID501 persistent SDK transport. Both retain live compiler runtime at space; all start/exec/exit/removal costs stay in whole wall. This is not directly comparable to the earlier per-command-container series.
Runtime setup and software baseline reported separately from full sample wall.
Both retain target/cache and three live views at final space.
Raw per-product stdout JSON preserves exact integer nanoseconds; parsed diagnostics may not.
